_about: FM broadcast receiver with RDS: picks a station, writes its audio to fm_audio.wav and decodes RDS (station name, RadioText, PI, programme type) using SDR Pilot's sp_wbfm_receiver + sp_rds_decoder blocks (gr-rds). RDS appears in the run log as SPDATA lines and in the dashboard's Decoded view.
use_when: listening to / recording an FM broadcast station, or reading its RDS station name and RadioText

variables_help.station: station frequency in Hz (e.g. 100.1e6). Default: the frequency the radio is tuned to. For a HackRF/zero-IF radio tune ~250 kHz away from the station and set station, so it isn't on the DC spike

spec.name: fm_rds_receiver
spec.title: FM broadcast + RDS
spec.description: sp_wbfm_receiver -> WAV audio; FM multiplex -> sp_rds_decoder -> sp_data_sink (decoded RDS)

blocks.name: out
blocks.note: decoded RDS -> SPDATA records (job summary 'decoded' + dashboard Decoded view)
